# Component Reference — @tackle/design-system

## Layout & Shell

### ApplicationShell
Wraps the entire app. Composes `Navigation` + main content area.

| Prop | Type | Notes |
|------|------|-------|
| `children` | `ReactNode` | Main content |
| `logo` | `ReactNode` | Sidebar logo |
| `navigationItems` | `NavigationItem[]` | `{ id, icon, label, divider? }` |
| `activeNavigationItemId` | `string` | Currently active nav item |
| `collapsed` / `onToggle` | `boolean` / `() => void` | Sidebar collapse |
| `accountName` | `string` | Footer account display |
| `environmentLabel` | `string` | Footer environment badge |
| `userName` / `userEmail` | `string` | Footer user info |

### SalesforceOpportunityShell
Salesforce Lightning Experience record page layout. Renders global header, opportunity record header, highlights panel, sales path, tabbed content area with a 320px right sidebar slot (for TackleCard), and a fixed utility bar. Use for **Tackle for Salesforce — Opportunity record** pages.

| Prop | Type | Notes |
|------|------|-------|
| `opportunityName` | `string` | **Required.** Record name in the header. |
| `recordType` | `string` | Label above the name (default `"Opportunity"`). |
| `headerActions` | `ReactNode` | Buttons to the right of the record header. |
| `highlights` | `{ label: string; value: string }[]` | Key-value pairs in the highlights panel. |
| `pathStages` | `{ label: string; state: 'done' \| 'active' \| 'upcoming' }[]` | Sales path stage-gate indicator. |
| `onMarkStageComplete` | `() => void` | Called when "Mark Stage as Complete" is clicked. |
| `tabs` | `{ id: string; label: string }[]` | Tab definitions for the main content area. |
| `activeTab` | `string` | Currently active tab id. |
| `onTabChange` | `(tabId: string) => void` | Called when a tab is clicked. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | Content rendered in the active tab panel. |
| `sidebarContent` | `ReactNode` | Content for the 320px right sidebar (typically `TackleCard`). |
| `utilityBarItems` | `{ label: string; onClick?: () => void }[]` | Items in the fixed utility bar. |
| `navItems` | `SalesforceNavItem[]` | Global header subnav items. |
| `activeNavItem` | `string` | Active subnav item (matched by label). |
| `onNavItemClick` | `(label: string) => void` | Called when a subnav item is clicked. |
| `className` | `string` | Additional CSS class on the root element. |

### SalesforceDrilldownShell
Tackle Platform detail drill-down and form pages rendered inside the Salesforce canvas iFrame. These are Platform pages hosted in Salesforce — they use Platform content patterns but render without the Navigation sidebar. Provides global header, breadcrumb navigation, page title, flex layout with main content and 220px quick links sidebar, and a fixed sticky action bar. Use for **Tackle for Salesforce — Detail or form page** contexts.

| Prop | Type | Notes |
|------|------|-------|
| `pageTitle` | `string` | **Required.** Page heading below the breadcrumb. |
| `pageIcon` | `ReactNode` | Icon to the left of the page title. |
| `breadcrumbs` | `{ label: string; onClick?: () => void }[]` | Breadcrumb trail above the title. Clickable items get `onClick`. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | Main form content (primary content column). |
| `quickLinks` | `{ label: string; href?: string; active?: boolean }[]` | Links in the 220px sticky sidebar. |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` | Buttons in the fixed sticky footer (e.g. Cancel, Submit). |
| `navItems` | `SalesforceNavItem[]` | Global header subnav items. |
| `activeNavItem` | `string` | Active subnav item (matched by label). |
| `onNavItemClick` | `(label: string) => void` | Called when a subnav item is clicked. |
| `className` | `string` | Additional CSS class on the root element. |

## Form Controls

### TextField
| Prop | Type | Notes |
|------|------|-------|
| `label` | `string` | Rendered via `FormLabel` |
| `helperText` | `string` | |
| `error` | `boolean` | |
| `errorMessage` | `string` | |
| `multiline` | `boolean` | Renders `<textarea>` |
| `rows` | `number` | When multiline |
| `leftIcon` / `rightIcon` | `ReactNode` | |
| `maxLength` | `number` | |
| `showCharacterCount` | `boolean` | |
| `type` | `string` | `text` \| `number` \| `email` \| `password` \| `url` \| `tel` |
| `required` / `disabled` | `boolean` | |

### Checkbox
Standard `<input>` props (minus `type`) + `label: string`, `indeterminate: boolean`.

### CheckboxGroup
| Prop | Type |
|------|------|
| `label` | `string` |
| `helperText` | `string` |
| `error` / `errorMessage` | `boolean` / `string` |
| `required` / `disabled` | `boolean` |
| `direction` | `'vertical'` \| `'horizontal'` |
| `columns` | `1` \| `2` \| `3` |
| `children` | `ReactNode` (Checkbox instances) |

### Radio
`value: string` (required), `label: string`, `name: string`, `disabled: boolean`

### RadioGroup
Same group props as CheckboxGroup + `orientation`, `columns`, `name`, `value`, `onChange`.

### Switch
Checkbox-like + `role="switch"`. Props: `label`, `checked`, `onChange`, `disabled`.

### SwitchGroup
Same grouping model as CheckboxGroup.

### ComboBox
| Prop | Type | Notes |
|------|------|-------|
| `options` | `ComboBoxOption[]` | `{ value, label }` |
| `multiple` | `boolean` | |
| `value` / `values` | `string` / `string[]` | Single vs multi |
| `onChange` / `onValuesChange` | Callbacks | |
| `label` / `helperText` / `error` | Standard form props | |
| `placeholder` | `string` | |

### Dropdown
| Prop | Type | Notes |
|------|------|-------|
| `type` | `'default'` \| `'sort'` | Sort shows direction toggle |
| `options` | `DropdownOption[]` | `{ value, label }` |

| `onChange` | `(value: string) => void` | |
| `label` | `string` | |
| `sortDirection` / `onSortDirectionChange` | `'asc'`\|`'desc'` / callback | Sort type only |
| `width` / `menuWidth` | `string` | |

### FormLabel
`label: string`, `htmlFor: string`, `state: 'default'|'focus'|'error'|'none'`, `required: boolean`

### HelperText
`children: ReactNode`, `type: 'guidance'|'error'|'counter'|'none'`

### GroupLabel
`children: ReactNode`, `state: 'default'|'error'|'none'`, `required: boolean`, `id: string`

### SelectionTag
`label: string`, `onRemove?: () => void` (removable if present), `disabled: boolean`

### Tag
`label: string`, `color: 'blue'|'red'|'purple'|'green'|'gray'|'yellow'`

### TackleCard
Responsive panel displaying Prospect intelligence, Co-Sell opportunities, and Marketplace Offers for an account. Defaults to 320 x 600 px but scales to fit any containing region (e.g. Salesforce sidebar slot).

| Prop | Type | Notes |
|------|------|-------|
| `variant` | `'prospect'` \| `'cosell'` \| `'offers'` | Which tab content to show by default. |
| `className` | `string` | Additional CSS class. |

## Icon Catalog

All icons accept `size: 'small'|'medium'|'large'|'xl'|number` and `color?: string` (default `currentColor`). Import from `@tackle/design-system`.
